data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €312.45
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterstadt issued the income tax assessment for 2025, dated 15 September 2026. Tax is set at €1,234.00, and a refund of €312.45 will be paid to your account at Musterbank eG.
data.explanation: This is your tax assessment (Steuerbescheid) for 2025. The tax office set your income tax at €1,234.00. Your employer already withheld €1,546.45, so you get €312.45 back. No solidarity surcharge applies. You don't have to pay anything. If you disagree, for example because you think deductions are missing, you may file an objection (Einspruch). The app shows until when. Check that the refund reaches your account. Keep the notice for your records. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
